answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the tide of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The wharf is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble.
